# Creator Examples

> A plain-text database of creator content examples (YouTube intros, short-form video scripts, and more), kept by Riley Brown. Every page is unstyled HTML. Machine-readable JSON lives under /data/.

- Home: https://creator-examples.vercel.app/
- Intros index: https://creator-examples.vercel.app/intros/
- Short Form index: https://creator-examples.vercel.app/short-form/
- Data index: https://creator-examples.vercel.app/data/index.json
- Skill for agents: https://creator-examples.vercel.app/skill/SKILL.md

- Method: Top 10 of 270 uploads (Sept 2025 to Sept 2026) ranked by views divided by channel median views (104.5K). Intro = spoken opening up to the sentence that hands off to the sponsor read. Transcripts from OutlierKit via Composio; video list via Monid.

Sponsored posts left out: anything Instagram marks as a paid partnership or whose caption carries a partner tag (#lumapartner, #chatgptpartner), which dropped 5 of his top 14.
